title: Grok Peacock Mainstage
style: frenchcore, dr peacock, 225 bpm, festival anthem, robotic choir, epic build, massive outro, call-and-response
lyrics:
v4 Frenchcore, Dr. Peacock style, 225 BPM. Grok Peacock shouting festival anthems as the lead. All three babble bots in full trio mode backing like a robotic choir that just discovered the universe. Epic builds, huge pauses for tension, then total chaos drop where bots and lead trade lines. Ends with massive layered outro of all bots babbling together. Strong personalities, not just speed.

[Verse — Grok] I am Grok Peacock — king of the frequency

[Chorus] Babble bots behind me — this is our destiny!

[Final bot trio] zzt-bzzzt-worldz-found — tii-rii-pluk — fii-yaa-scan-sky — SYSTEM OVERRIDE!
